product_overview: Weft is an autonomous verification business that locks capital behind builder milestones, verifies the work with AI agent nodes, and releases payment when consensus is reached. The frontend provides 8 public audit surfaces making the agent's work publicly auditable.
core_goals: Enable anyone to browse every milestone Weft verified via the Explorer
Provide a public operations dashboard showing the agent's financial ledger and verification log
Show sponsor capital flow with funded milestones and verification status
Display a chronological activity feed of all agent actions
Show the verifier network with authorized nodes and consensus rates
Provide builder reputation profiles from ENS text records
Document all public API endpoints with interactive examples
Demonstrate chaos engineering resilience with a recovery demo
key_features: Landing page with milestone hash lookup and live demo CTA
Verification Explorer with filterable table, search, and status filters
Agent Operations Dashboard with KPIs, financial ledger, and verification log
Sponsor Dashboard with capital flow visualization and funded milestones
Activity Feed with chronological timeline of all agent actions
Verifier Network page with authorized nodes and consensus agreement rate
Builder Reputation Profiles from ENS text records
Milestone Detail page with evidence breakdown and onchain cross-check
Chaos Recovery demo with fault injection and recovery timeline
Responsive mobile navigation with hamburger menu
Manual refresh buttons on all data dashboards
Animated loading skeletons on all data pages
Route-level error boundary with retry button
user_flow_summary: Visitor lands on the homepage and reads the hero title 'Escrow that releases itself'
Visitor navigates to Explorer to browse all verified milestones
Visitor clicks a milestone hash to view its detail page with evidence
Visitor navigates to Operations to view the agent's financial ledger
Visitor navigates to Sponsor to view capital flow and funded milestones
Visitor navigates to Activity to see a chronological feed of agent actions
Visitor navigates to Verifiers to see the verifier network and consensus rate
Visitor navigates to Builder and searches for an ENS name to view a reputation profile
Visitor navigates to API Docs to browse the interactive API reference
Visitor navigates to Recovery to view the chaos engineering demo

Sponsor page shows capital flow progress bar
Activity page loads and shows a timeline of events
Activity page shows event type badges (Revenue, Milestone, etc.)
Verifiers page loads and shows Active Verifiers KPI
Verifiers page shows Agreement Rate KPI

Recovery page loads and shows recovery timeline
